title: Checking Ingredients at a Potluck
context: Nina 在朋友 Sam 的聚餐中对花生过敏；两人查看包装并在无法确认食物成分时选择不吃。 本课属于 2026-11-22 预制系列，题目是原创口语练习，并非真实考试题。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Everything looks lovely, Sam. Could I ask about the snacks?
dialogue.zh: Sam，这些食物看起来真不错。我能问问零食的事吗？

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Sure. What would you like to know?

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: I have a peanut allergy. Do you still have the package for these crackers?
dialogue.zh: 我对花生过敏。你还留着这些饼干的包装吗？

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Yes, it's in the kitchen. Let's read the label together.
dialogue.zh: 有，在厨房。我们一起看看标签吧。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Thanks. I want to check the ingredients and any allergy information.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我想看看配料和过敏原相关信息。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Here's the package. Take your time.

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: The crackers aren't a choice I'm comfortable with, so I'll skip them.
dialogue.zh: 这些饼干让我不太放心，我就不吃了。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Of course. I also brought some fruit in its original container.
dialogue.zh: 当然可以。我还带了一些水果，装在原来的容器里。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: May I check that label too?
dialogue.zh: 我可以也看看那个标签吗？

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Absolutely. I don't know what's in the homemade dip, though.
dialogue.zh: 当然可以。不过我不知道自制蘸酱里有什么。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Then I'll pass on the dip. I'll have the fruit after checking it.
dialogue.zh: 那我就不吃蘸酱了。检查过以后我吃水果。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Sounds good. Thanks for telling me what you need.
dialogue.zh: 好。谢谢你告诉我你的需求。

expressions.zh: 对某物过敏；可接 to 加具体物质。
expressions.example: I have an allergy to peanuts.
Please read the label on the jar.
Take your time choosing a seat.
I'll pass on the sauce, thank you.

pronunciation: allergy 重音在第一个音节；label 也重读第一个音节，末尾是轻读的 bəl。

practice.title: Part 1 · Sharing food
practice.prompt: Do you enjoy sharing food with friends?
practice.answer: Yes. I like trying different dishes, and I appreciate it when friends tell me what is in them.

practice.title: Part 2 · A meal with others
practice.prompt: Describe a meal you shared with other people. Say where it was, what you ate, and what made it memorable.
practice.answer: A friend invited me to a lunch where everyone brought something. I brought sliced fruit in its original container. Before eating, one guest asked about the ingredients in a snack, and we looked at the package together. She chose the fruit after checking its label and politely declined a dip with unknown ingredients. I remember the lunch because everyone listened and made her feel welcome. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Inclusive gatherings
practice.prompt: How can hosts help guests with different food needs feel welcome?
practice.answer: Hosts can ask guests about their needs in advance and keep ingredient information available. They can also respect a guest's decision to avoid a dish without making them feel uncomfortable.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读后礼貌说明过敏情况，要求查看标签，并婉拒无法确认成分的食物。
practice.answer: I have a peanut allergy. May I check the package? I can't confirm what's in the dip, so I'll pass, thank you.
